newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat continues to drift lower.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat continues to drift lower.

text.p: Argentine wheat continued to drift lower Thursday in slow cash trade on Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with slow export sales providing no impetus.
Maize was firm, helped by speculation about the spread of Rio Cuarto disease and talk of poor weather in the United States. Sellers were holding back on hopes that prices still have more upside.
Soybeans were slightly firmer on export demand. Sunflower seeds were little changed with crusher demand thin.
